decision.explanation: The sources describe three distinct individuals named 'Walter Erskine' (or variations like Walter Henry Erskine and Walter John Francis Erskine) who held the title of Earl of Mar and Kellie at different times. D1S4 explicitly states Walter Henry Erskine became Earl of Mar in 1875. D3S3 states Walter John Francis Erskine succeeded his father in 1888 (becoming 12th Earl of Mar and 14th Earl of Kellie). D2S2 explicitly states 'Walter Erskine became the Earl of Mar and Kellie in 1920'. Since the question asks for the year 'Walter Erskine' became the Earl without specifying which individual, and the sources provide distinct valid years for different persons with this name holding the title, all three years are retained as complementary valid answers corresponding to distinct referents.
